Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Shedd
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 60 as introduced for the continuance of the Alabama Board for Registered Interior Designers until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Shedd
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 60 as passed the House of Representatives for the continuance of the Alabama Board for Registered Interior Designers until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
